ruleset.name: mailkube-spring-boot-test
ruleset.description:
Tests keep the complexity and dead-code rules but not the documentation one: a test method's name is its documentation.
This restates its rules rather than referencing ruleset.xml and excluding one, which would be the DRY form. PMD resolves a `ref` against the CLASSPATH, not against the referencing file, so `ref="config/pmd/ruleset.xml"`, `"./ruleset.xml"` and `"ruleset.xml"` all fail — and they fail the way this toolchain always fails: PMD logs "Cannot load ruleset", analyzes nothing, and the build goes GREEN. All three were tried. Do not "fix" this without checking the pmdTest output.
